skills.description:
Convert a speech transcript or speaker notes into a polished PPT deck with a
user-chosen visual style and a user-specified page count. Use when the user
says "把这段演讲稿做成 PPT", "speech to slides", "把讲话整理成幻灯片",
"根据这个发言做 N 页 PPT", or provides a talk script and asks for a deck.
Always two-step: produce an outline first, wait for user approval, then render
the deck. Do NOT use this skill when the user already has a PPTX that needs
editing (use the `pptx` skill), when the input is not a speech/talk
